transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, mostly I’m here because I’m just really tired, but... it's in a way that sleep doesn’t seem to fix. Like, even just doing basic things, like unloading the dishwasher, or trying to read for my certificate class... it can just feel like too much right now.
After physical or mental activity, do you experience a delayed worsening of your fatigue or other symptoms?

I don't think so. Um... it's not really a delayed thing. It's more just that doing the activity itself is exhausting right then and there. I haven't really noticed it getting worse hours later or the next day, if that's what you mean. I'm just kind of consistently tired.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um... no, not really. I don't think I feel depressed. I mean, I'm not sad or crying or anything like that. It's really just the lack of energy. I just feel drained all the time, but my mood itself isn't really down.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Yeah, actually. Um... I've just stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. Like, I normally enjoy sketching, or going to gallery openings, but I haven't wanted to do any of that. Same with cooking, or yoga... or even just playing tennis with a friend. I just don't have any interest in them right now.
How long have you been feeling less interested in the activities you usually enjoy?
I'd say it's been about three months. This whole quieter stretch, where I just have low interest in things and all that heavy fatigue... yeah, it's been going on for roughly three months now.
Have you noticed any significant change in your sleep, such as sleeping much more or much less than usual?
No, my sleep hasn't really changed. I mean, I still sleep about the same amount I usually do. I'm just tired during the day, but at night... I'm sleeping fine. Not more or less than normal.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions lately?

Yes, I have. It's been pretty frustrating, honestly. Like, I’ll sit there with my planning app open, and I still won't be able to decide what to do first. I can't figure out whether to work on a class assignment, pay a bill, or just start dinner. So I usually just end up doing none of it for a while because I just can't seem to choose or focus on a task.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite recently?

Yeah, actually. My appetite has been pretty off lately. Um, sometimes I'll just realize it's the end of the day and all I've had is coffee and maybe a few bites of something. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but my jeans have definitely gotten a lot looser.
Have you had any thoughts about dying or hurting yourself?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I know I've been struggling with getting things done and feeling a bit off, but... no, I definitely haven't wanted to hurt myself or die. Nothing like that at all.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. On my slower days, it honestly feels like my body is moving through wet cement. Everything just takes so much effort. And it's not just moving... even when my spouse asks me a simple question, it can take me a weirdly long time to just get the words out to answer him.
